sections.markdown:
## C — Knowledge dossier: School buses and parking

FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A43
The handbook requires stopping when a school bus flashes red lights or extends its stop arm, with an exception stated for a roadway separated by a physical barrier. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A43
Proceed slowly and watch for children only after the school bus’s red flashing lights stop and its stop arm is no longer visible. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A43
Park in a designated area and ensure the parked vehicle does not create a hazard or interfere with travel. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A43
Roadside parking should be as far from moving traffic as possible and as close to an existing curb as possible. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A43
A parked vehicle must be visible to traffic approaching from either direction. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A43
Normally apply the parking brake and leave an automatic vehicle in Park or a manual vehicle in its lowest gear. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A43
If cold conditions could freeze the parking brake on, the handbook allows leaving it off while still using Park or the lowest gear. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A43
Parking on a rural highway must leave at least 15 feet of roadway for other traffic to pass. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: A43
A vehicle parked on a rural highway must be visible from at least 500 feet in both directions. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A43
After dark, a vehicle parked on a rural highway must have its parking lights and taillights on. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A43
Exit on the curb side if possible; otherwise check traffic before opening the street-side door and close it promptly after leaving. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F12 | anchor: A43
Do not leave the ignition key in a parked vehicle, and make locking the doors on exit a habit. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F13 | anchor: A43
Before hill parking, check mirrors and blind spots, signal right, slow while leaving traffic and stop as far right as possible. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F14 | anchor: A43
When parked uphill beside a curb, turn the wheels sharply left. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F15 | anchor: A43
When parked downhill or without a curb, turn the wheels sharply right so rolling would lead away from traffic. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F16 | anchor: A43
For hill parking, apply the emergency brake and use Park in an automatic, Reverse in a manual facing downhill, or the lowest manual gear facing uphill. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec12-F17 | anchor: A43
Before leaving a parked position, signal, check mirrors and blind spots, and enter traffic only when safe. [A43]
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0043]

Misconceptions: A school-bus warning has an expressly printed physical-barrier exception whose direction-specific application is not clarified here; hill parking changes wheel position and manual-transmission gear.
Mnemonics: Use stop signal, visibility, brake, gear and wheel direction as an authored cue.
Glossary: A stop arm is the bus’s extended stop device; angle and perpendicular parking differ from parallel parking; the parking brake secures a stopped vehicle.
Dynamic facts: Parking designations and bus-route layouts vary by location. No unprinted no-parking distance or curb-color meaning is invented.

ranked.label: Pedagogic emphasis: Recognize bus stop signals and preserve parking distances, gears and wheel directions.

items.why: Bus stopping, hill parking and parking-space maneuvers require distinct practice.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
